question: Where is the nearest park positioned in the southeast direction of Bowling Green Ballpark, Bowling Green, KY?
sql: SELECT P.park_name FROM parks AS P, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bowling Green Ballpark%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bowling Green%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 ) AS B WHERE degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(B.geometry), ST_Centroid(P.geometry))) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5 ORDER BY B.geometry <-> P.geometry LIMIT 1;
